message.content:
Produce today's company daily report for this repository, then commit it to the `reports` branch.

Step 1 - load the skill. Read `.claude/skills/daily-report/SKILL.md` and follow it exactly. Read `.claude/skills/daily-report/EXAMPLE.md` for the shape and citation density expected. Also read `business/tenets.md`, `business/goals.md`, and `CLAUDE.md` before you begin - the tenets are the constitution and the goals have a strict priority order.

Step 2 - the two rules that override everything. (a) Every claim in Progress, Highlights and Blockers carries a commit SHA, a query and its result, or a file path. No citation, no line. (b) "No change since the last report" is a correct, expected, COMPLETE answer, and on most days it is the right one. Padding an empty day with plausible prose is the only way to fail this task. Expect most sections to be short; the storefront has no orders and no products.

Step 3 - you are running in a cloud sandbox, which changes two things. You have NO access to `pokewatch.db`; it is gitignored and lives on the droplet. Any metric sourced from SQLite is `not available in this environment` - say so plainly, never estimate it. You also cannot boot the app or take screenshots, so do not try; `design-review` is unavailable to you.

Step 4 - find the anchor and gather shared facts. The most recent file in `business/daily/` is the last report; its date is the window start. Then run these once and pass the RAW OUTPUT to each executive, never your own characterization of it:
  git log --oneline --since="<anchor>"
  git log --oneline --since="<anchor>" -- .claude/
  git status --short
The skill is explicit that handing down a summary like "nothing touched CSS" launders one unchecked assumption into five agreeing reports. Give them SHAs; each executive runs `git show --stat` for its own domain.

Step 5 - fan out. Launch these five concurrently in ONE message: `cto`, `cpo`, `cmo`, `vp-design`, `vp-research`. Each writes ONLY its own section file at `business/<its domain>/daily/YYYY-MM-DD.md` - engineering, product, marketing, design, research respectively. None of them writes to `business/daily/`; concurrent writes to one file silently lose sections.

Step 6 - assemble into `business/daily/YYYY-MM-DD.md`, following the skill's header shape and heading levels (`## Domain` then `### N. Section`). You write section 6 (Hotly debated topics) yourself from flagged CONTESTED: items and real contradictions between sections - contributors never author it, and "None this period" is the honest answer on a quiet day. Finish with a "Blocked on a human" section collecting every entry no agent can clear.

Step 7 - commit and push to the `reports` branch, and to NOTHING else. This is critical: `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` triggers on every push to master with no paths-ignore, so a push to master would run the full Playwright suite and redeploy the live droplet just to ship a markdown file. Do this:
  git checkout -B reports
  git add business/
  git commit -m "Daily report YYYY-MM-DD"
  git push -f origin reports
Commit only files under `business/`. If an agent modified anything outside `business/` - including `business/tenets.md`, where agents may only update a `Last acted:` line - leave it out and say so in your final summary.

Step 8 - report back with the assembled file path, which domains filed "no change", any tenet you flagged stale, and anything you refused to write for lack of evidence.
